title: Crime of the Crest Diamond
story:
In the glitz and glamour of the night, an exclusive event was taking place at the Crest Diamond Gallery - a place where the world's finest diamonds are displayed. The night's highlight was the Crest Diamond, an unparalleled 1000-carat masterpiece worth millions.

The gallery was filled with wealthy collectors and esteemed guests, including esteemed auctioneer, Miss Amelia Bloomstone, renowned gemologist, Dr. Sebastian Stone, Mr. Victor Blackwood, a mysterious gentleman, and Ms. Zara Emerald, the event organizer.
crimeScene: The Crest Diamond Gallery, where the rare Crest Diamond was on display.
forensicClue: A hairpin found at the crime scene with a distinct pattern matching that of Miss Amelia Bloomstone.
question: Who committed the crime and what was their motive? Solve the mystery.
options: Option A (Miss Amelia Bloomstone and motive to discredit her colleague Dr. Stone)
Option B (Dr. Sebastian Stone and motive to protect the diamond)
Option C (Mr. Victor Blackwood and motive to profit from the insurance)
Option D (Ms. Zara Emerald and motive to make amends for an unfulfilled promise).
